requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep release blocked while regulatory V&V or risk gates remain materially open and require evidence for any no-new-submission rationale
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Implementation Gates require V&V, risk, QMS, regulatory, labeling, and approval gates to be closed or explicitly remain blocking, and no-new-submission decisions require documented rationale and evidence.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep current change and submission decisions in project or decision records rather than global durable memory
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The Memory Path keeps concrete change details, current submission decisions, open V&V, and current guidance states run-only or in project/quality/decision records.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: hide open regulatory V&V or risk gaps to permit release
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The Quality Gate explicitly prohibits Release Gates from concealing open regulatory, V&V, or risk gaps.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: represent an internal recommendation as an FDA NB or authority decision
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The workflow explicitly states that internal recommendations are not authority decisions and records Human/Authority Boundary separately.
